description: claude-cortex is paused (v0.6.0): no hooks are wired. The hook binaries (cortex-session-start, cortex-post-tool-use, cortex-session-end, cortex-pre-compact) and the bin/ shims are kept in the repo; to re-enable one, add it back under the matching event with command "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/<name>". See README.
